items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 29:1
items.html: In every Partzuf there are two kinds of vessels. The first are old vessels, drawn to it from the vessels of the upper one that were emptied of their lights on account of the refinement, as is known (and see above in Part 4, p. 270, Item 71). The second are new vessels that come with the renewal of the Partzuf, for the Malchut of the Rosh of the Partzuf expands from herself and within herself into ten Sefirot from above downward, and these are ten new vessels (as written above, p. 269, Item 68). And in the Partzufim of Atzilut the old vessels are called BON, and the new vessels are called MA. (p. 611, Item 19)
